ninja-tune.works: A wall of square record covers does all the work; the chrome stays tiny, grey and out of the way.
ninja-tune.lesson: Let the sound's artwork (the synth's prints) be the colour; keep the frame quiet.

warp.works: Full-bleed live photography with harsh coloured light; a thin nav bar and almost no type on top.
warp.lesson: Coloured light on black is the mood; one strong image beats several weak ones.

aphex-twin.works: Deliberately broken: pixel and terminal type, raw text dumped on black, nothing polished.
aphex-twin.goodFor: An outlier for texture and attitude, not for structure.
aphex-twin.lesson: A little controlled rawness (a decayed-signal line, mono labels) reads as authentic; a lot reads as a joke.

ghostly.works: A dense, typographic catalogue: mono labels, serif headings, filters as plain text lists.
ghostly.goodFor: Preset browsers, filter UIs, long lists.
ghostly.lesson: Mono for data and labels, a softer face for names: a tidy way to show a big preset bank.

nin.works: Black, red and a hard industrial logo; one product block in the centre, nav as a short vertical list.
nin.lesson: Restraint: two colours and one object can feel heavier than a whole page of effects.

johann-johannsson.works: A single quiet photograph, a tiny serif name, enormous white space: grief and stillness.
johann-johannsson.lesson: Stillness is a design tool: give one image room and say almost nothing.

max-richter.works: A surreal full-bleed still, a light-weight sans with tight tracking, a thin ticket bar at the bottom.
max-richter.goodFor: Cinematic heroes with a single announcement.
max-richter.lesson: A dream-like image plus one quiet line feels expensive; avoid stacking buttons on it.

nils-frahm.works: Texture everywhere: a warm, grainy, distorted portrait over a patterned ground; thin wide-tracked caps.
nils-frahm.lesson: Grain and warmth make digital feel analog: the same job tape wear does in the synth.

jon-hopkins.works: Deep blue darkness with one small figure; a tiny nav floating on top; huge negative space.
jon-hopkins.lesson: Scale contrast (a tiny subject in a big dark space) creates awe cheaply.

a24.works: Giant tight-tracked grotesk set straight over a film still; the type is part of the image.
a24.lesson: Big confident type over the product can carry the whole first screen.

neon.works: Condensed, very heavy titles over full-bleed stills, a dark floating nav pill.
neon.lesson: Condensed heavy type gives instant poster energy.

remedy.works: A rainy, dim photograph with almost no UI; the brand mark small in a corner.
remedy.lesson: Let the atmosphere load before anything asks for attention.

supermassive.works: Dark cinematic key art with centred, thin, widely tracked caps over it.
supermassive.lesson: Thin wide caps over dark art is close to our current hero; keep it but cut the clutter.

playdead.works: Near-monochrome greys, a small nav row, one silent landscape image.
playdead.lesson: Desaturated, quiet frames feel more dread-filled than loud ones.

bloober.works: A red logo glowing out of a dark textured scene; centred statement and one outlined button.
bloober.lesson: A single red accent in a sea of near-black: the same move as our ember.

rick-owens.works: Stark black and white, tiny caps everywhere, the product photographed brutally.
rick-owens.lesson: Tiny type and big imagery is how luxury says it doesn't need to shout.

hasselblad.works: A glowing gold ring on pure black with thin, widely tracked caps: a product reveal as an eclipse.
hasselblad.lesson: Light emerging from black is our safelight idea done perfectly.

moog.works: A close, warmly lit macro shot of real hardware; dark nav, the instrument as a precious object.
moog.lesson: Shoot (or render) the synth like an object under one warm light.

analogue.works: A clean light studio shot of the product, centred, with one short title and a pill button.
analogue.lesson: Product, name, one button: the cleanest possible buy path.

polaroid.works: Real photographs scattered like on a table; texture and warmth from the medium itself.
polaroid.lesson: Showing artefacts (prints, tape, notes) makes a digital product feel physical.

apple-airpods-max.works: One huge product image, one big headline, price and Buy in a small pill: nothing else.
apple-airpods-max.lesson: A tiny persistent price-plus-Buy pill: what our phone pin bar wants to be.

apple-macbook-pro.works: Black page, products as glowing objects, short centred copy, two small blue links.
apple-macbook-pro.lesson: On black, let the product be the only light source.

apple-vision-pro.works: A bright face and product, a short wordmark and one line; motion sells the experience.
apple-vision-pro.lesson: Show the experience (sound, motion), not only the object.

teenage-engineering.works: A single object in dramatic top light on black; thin, light type set very small; a playful icon nav.
teenage-engineering.lesson: Dramatic top light plus tiny type is the closest product-photo match to RUIN-1's mood.

nothing.works: A dot-matrix and mono identity; bold product photography; big serif-ish headline at the bottom left.
nothing.lesson: An ownable type detail (like their dot font) makes a brand recognisable at a glance.

leica.works: Warm cinematic photography with a clean white headline and one white pill; a quiet tab row at the bottom.
leica.lesson: A bottom row of product tabs under the hero is a neat way to jump between pages.

marshall.works: Heavy condensed caps, gritty textures, music-gear attitude. (The consent box could not be dismissed in capture.)
marshall.lesson: Grit and weight in the type can carry the brand's sound.

bowers-wilkins.works: Soft grey studio light, products standing like sculptures, a thin elegant headline.
bowers-wilkins.lesson: Calm studio light makes audio gear feel high-end.

kef.works: A lifestyle room scene with the product in place, a centred title and two buttons.
kef.lesson: Showing the synth in a dark studio scene could sell the mood fast.

mubi.works: Dark, intimate film still, a big uppercase line and one email field with a solid button.
mubi.lesson: One clear action on a moody image: a template for a 'Get the free trial' hero.

elektron.works: Saturated colour-blocked studio shot of hardware and cables; dark nav; the product among real gear.
elektron.lesson: Show RUIN-1 inside a real setup to prove it belongs in one.

ableton.works: Real studio photography with a hand-drawn headline; friendly and human.
ableton.lesson: A human touch (handwriting, real rooms) offsets a dark technical brand.

koenigsegg.works: A machine shot from behind under cold light, a huge brand-script title, almost no UI.
koenigsegg.lesson: A single dramatic angle and one huge title can carry a first screen.

polestar.works: Cold grey photography, precise small type, lots of space, a quiet two-button pair.
polestar.lesson: Precision (alignment, small type, grey) reads as engineering quality.

lucid.works: Warm evening photography, a serif-tinged wordmark, a white button floating on the image.
lucid.lesson: Golden-hour warmth against dark tones is a luxury signal.

rivian.works: Big bold headline on an outdoor shot, a bright yellow accent button.
rivian.lesson: One saturated accent button against natural imagery pops hard: our ember does the same.

linear.works: Near-black, precise Inter type with tight tracking, the product UI as the hero image.
linear.lesson: Show the real interface big, framed in near-black, with tight confident type.

raycast.works: Abstract red light streaks on black behind a centred headline; glossy and premium.
raycast.lesson: A red light effect behind the headline is close to our safelight; keep it abstract and soft.

arc.works: A colourful logo on black with an expressive serif headline and one small button.
arc.lesson: One message, one button, a lot of black.

vercel.works: A single geometric shape, tight large type and a logo strip: ultra-minimal.
vercel.lesson: A row of partner/press logos is a cheap trust signal we lack.

framer.works: Dark page, product UI glowing in blue, short headline, two small buttons.
framer.lesson: A glowing UI on black (like our pages strip) is exactly the right instinct.

cursor.works: Warm off-white, a calm serif accent, the product window as the image.
cursor.lesson: Even a technical tool can feel warm with a little serif and soft tone.

superhuman.works: A dreamy gradient sky with a person and floating UI cards; soft, aspirational.
superhuman.lesson: Mostly a contrast: the opposite of RUIN-1's mood.

pentagram.works: Massive type and solid colour fields; the work at billboard scale.
pentagram.lesson: Scale and colour discipline: big work, tiny labels.

basic.works: Dark product photography with a round 'watch reel' button floating on it.
basic.lesson: A round floating play button on the hero invites sound and motion.

locomotive.works: Pixelated, red, glitchy portrait with a grotesk-plus-serif lockup; very editorial.
locomotive.lesson: A pixel/decay effect in red is close to our decayed-signal header.

instrument.works: Huge black condensed wordmark over a grid of playful 3D characters.
instrument.lesson: A giant wordmark band can anchor a page: a cousin of mobile pitch 6D.

collins.works: A single centred serif line on white with lots of air; quiet confidence.
collins.lesson: One sentence, beautifully set, is often stronger than a feature list.

unseen.works: Pale, soft gradient with one tiny centred mark and a short line; it waits for you to scroll.
unseen.lesson: A calm loading moment can set the mood before the page reveals.

studio-freight.works: A scattered grid of work around a centred line, monospaced type, playful layout.
studio-freight.lesson: Breaking the grid on purpose shows confidence; use sparingly.

rockstar.works: Illustrated key art, big product title, two pill buttons and a pre-load call to action.
rockstar.lesson: Pre-order energy: one bold product logo, two clear actions.

naughty-dog.works: Heavy condensed caps over a dark textured background; story-first.
naughty-dog.lesson: Condensed heavy caps on dark texture: strong for launch news.

cd-projekt-red.works: A grey cinematic field with centred caps and a red accent; corporate yet dark.
cd-projekt-red.lesson: A single red accent and centred caps hold a corporate page together.

blumhouse.works: Saturated red light on a horror still with a heavy condensed title.
blumhouse.lesson: Red wash plus condensed type is pure dread: close to the darker LORN tracks.

ecm.works: Austere: a single album cover centred on white, tiny Univers type, nothing else.
ecm.lesson: One object, perfectly centred, with almost no chrome: maximum focus.

our-legacy.works: Big editorial photography with a bold caps location title, nearly no UI.
our-legacy.lesson: Location or scene labels over images add story with two words.

acronym.works: A strict grid of products on white, tiny technical labels, no decoration.
acronym.lesson: Technical, tiny labels give a precise, engineered feel.

olafur-arnalds.works: Split screen: a black-and-white photo beside a hand-drawn illustration and fine type.
olafur-arnalds.lesson: Pairing a photo with a delicate drawing adds intimacy.

native-instruments.works: A big lavender-and-purple burst behind the synth UI; busy nav and offers.
native-instruments.lesson: What to avoid: crowded offers and loud gradients around the product.

output.works: Loud colourful sale banner, big rounded type, many offers.
output.lesson: The bar we want to clear: no shouting, no sale clutter; let the sound and the dark do it.
